_readme: Single source of truth for which model each kind of task uses. Prices are USD per 1M tokens and MUST be re-checked on the provider pricing pages before relying on cost estimates (last checked from public list prices; providers change them). Providers other than openai are disabled until you add a key and set enabled=true.
currency_note: OpenAI bills in USD. Budgets in budget.json are CAD; router converts with usd_to_cad.

T1.purpose: classification, extraction, formatting, short summaries, routine replies

T2.purpose: routine research synthesis, marketing copy, comparisons, standard analysis

T3.purpose: financial evaluation, strategy, independent review of high-impact recommendations
T3.requires: only for tasks that passed T2 screening or that an approval depends on

rules: Escalate T1->T2 or T2->T3 at most once per task, only when the cheaper output fails validation (bad JSON, missing sources).
Fallback to the next provider in the chain only on 429/5xx/timeout, reusing the same task_id and full prompt so context is preserved.
Never fallback after a provider returned a successful answer (prevents duplicate actions).
If the next call would exceed any budget cap -> stop, log, ask the owner.
